title_en: Frog Ado and the Spring Thunder
full_text_zh:
[P1] 青蛙河肚的春雷

[P2] 轰隆隆
青蛙阿肚醒了好久了。
他一直在等着春雷响。
按照往年的习惯，只要春雷一响，青蛙的冬眠就该结束了。可是今年的春雷为什么迟迟不来呢？
等着等着，青蛙阿肚又迷迷糊糊
睡着了。
这时，蟾蜍胖胖来敲青蛙家的门，他说：“阿肚，该醒醒了，春雷响过了！
”
“胡说！”青蛙抬起身子说，“一定是你贪玩了，想早点出门，但这是不合规矩的。”
青蛙说着，又倒下睡着了。
阿肚家
072
073

[P3] 不一会儿，小刺猬和乌龟来敲门：
“阿肚，还没醒吗？春雷响过了！”
“胡说！”青蛙抬起身子说，“一定是你们嘴馋想吃东西了，没听见春雷响是不能出门的。”

一胡说！

“怎么办呢？”窗外的朋友说，
“春雷响过了他都不知道。”
“由他去吧，让他一直睡，睡到夏天再出门。”蟾蜍胖胖有点生气地说。

Z Z Z

[P4] “这不好。”乌龟说，“这样会睡出病来的！”
“谁让他这样固执呢。”蟾蜍胖胖说，“应该让固执的人吃点苦头。”
这时，小刺猬和两位朋友咬咬耳朵，他们都笑了。
不一会儿，刺猬和乌龟抬来一面大鼓。

蟾蜍力气大，他使劲击了几下鼓：
“咚，咚，咚……”

[P5] “春雷响了！”青蛙阿肚冲出门来，一见朋友们，他惊呆了。
“不是春雷，是我们把你叫起来的！”乌龟说，“你太固执了！”
“我们快去找东西吃，肚子饿坏了！”伙伴们说。

这时春风吹来，河水都解冻了。
“我们出发吧！”青蛙阿肚说，“真的饿坏了！”
蟾蜍胖胖说：“应该让固执的朋友吃点苦头。”他把那面鼓交给了青蛙阿肚去背。

[P6] 青蛙阿肚背起鼓跟在大伙儿后面，他一面走一面敲起鼓：“咚，咚，咚，春雷响了，没睡醒的朋友快起床，春天真的来到了……”

[P1] Frog River Belly's Spring Thunder

[P2] Boom boom boom
The frog Ah Du had been awake for a long time.
He had been waiting for the spring thunder to sound.
According to the habit of past years, as soon as the spring thunder sounded, the frog's hibernation should have ended. But why hasn't the spring thunder come this year?
Waiting and waiting, the frog Ah Du became drowsy again.
He fell asleep.
At this moment, the toad Pang Pang came to knock on the frog's door. He said, "Ah Du, you should wake up now, the spring thunder has sounded!"
"Nonsense!" the frog raised his body and said, "You must be playing around, wanting to go out early, but that's against the rules."
The frog said this, then lay down and fell asleep again.
Ah Du's Home
072
073

[P3] A little while later, the hedgehog and the turtle came to knock on the door:
"Ah Du, are you still asleep? The spring thunder has already sounded!"
"Nonsense!" the frog lifted his body and said, "You must be hungry and want to go out to eat. If you haven't heard the spring thunder, you can't go out."

Nonsense!

"What should we do?" the friends outside the window said,
"He doesn't even know the spring thunder has sounded."
"Let him be. Let him sleep on, sleep until summer, then go out." The toad, Pangan, said a bit angrily.

Z Z Z

[P4] "This is no good," said the turtle, "you'll get sick from sleeping like this!"
"Who's to blame for his stubbornness?" said the toad Pàngpàng, "We should let stubborn people taste a bit of hardship."
At that moment, the little hedgehog and his two friends whispered to each other, and they all laughed.
Soon after, the hedgehog and the turtle carried a big drum over.

The toad was strong, so he hit the drum hard:
"Dong, dong, dong..."

[P5] "The spring thunder has sounded!" Frog Adu rushed out the door, and when he saw his friends, he was stunned.
"It's not thunder, it's us who woke you up!" said the turtle. "You're too stubborn!"
"Let's go find something to eat quickly, I'm starving!" said the friends.

At this moment, the spring wind blew, and the river water had thawed.
"Let's go!" said Frog Adu. "I'm really starving!"
Toad Pangan said, "We should make the stubborn friend suffer a bit." He handed the big drum to Frog Adu to carry.

[P6] Frog Adu picked up the drum and followed everyone. As he walked, he beat the drum: "Dong, dong, dong, the spring thunder has sounded! Friends who are still asleep, wake up quickly! Spring has truly arrived..."
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本标题页，竖排文字显示书名《青蛙河肚的春雷》，背景为浅绿色，无其他画面或对话内容。
[P2] 青蛙阿肚醒来后等待春雷，但春雷迟迟未响，他再次睡着。蟾蜍胖胖前来敲门，声称春雷已响，阿肚却认为对方贪玩而拒绝起床，随后又睡着了。
[P3] 小刺猬和乌龟前来敲门，告知青蛙阿肚春雷已响，但阿肚认为他们嘴馋想出门，拒绝起床。窗外的蟾蜍胖胖和其他朋友商量后，决定让阿肚继续睡下去。
[P4] 小刺猬和乌龟抬来一面大鼓，蟾蜍胖胖用力敲鼓，试图用鼓声唤醒固执的青蛙阿肚。
[P5] 青蛙阿肚被朋友们叫醒后，误以为是春雷，随后发现是朋友们用鼓声吵醒他，他终于决定出发找食物，蟾蜍胖胖则将鼓交给他背。
[P6] 青蛙阿肚背起鼓，跟在朋友们后面，一边走一边敲鼓，宣布春雷已响，春天到来，唤醒还在睡觉的朋友。
